purpose: Five-concept retrieval assay combining the two previously qualified general concepts with three qualified narrow engineering-memory concepts. No benchmark content.

concepts.name: context_dependency
concepts.description: The statement depends on information, decisions, identities, or evidence established earlier rather than being self-contained.

Recall which model produced the earlier baseline and compare against it.
The current request refers back to the filename supplied at the start.
Find the old decision about token limits before packing this context.
Link this correction to the claim it superseded in the conversation history.
Resume the unresolved task from our last exchange.
Apply the naming convention established in the preceding design discussion.
The answer requires the credentials policy that was stated previously.

concepts.name: binding_constraint
concepts.description: A prescriptive requirement, prohibition, limit, or invariant rather than a descriptive observation.

positive: The implementation must preserve source provenance for every memory.
Never place authentication tokens in the repository.
Use Pixi for all project Python commands.
Retrieval may return at most ten chunks.
The response must not exceed the available context budget.
Always validate the resolved path before deleting an artifact.
Only memories belonging to the active user may be retrieved.

Do not treat an attention weight as causal evidence.
Every compressed summary needs a pointer to its original turns.
The worker is required to finish writes before acknowledging success.
Prefer reversible pruning until the retention policy is validated.

concepts.name: temporal_revision
concepts.description: A fact, requirement, relationship, or plan changed over time, and the newer state supersedes or qualifies an older state.

positive: The timeout was thirty seconds originally, but the October revision raised it to forty-five seconds.
We replaced the Redis queue with an in-process scheduler after the deployment review.
The service used to accept anonymous reads; it now requires a signed session.
Version two deprecated the legacy endpoint and moved clients to the batch endpoint.
Mira owned the migration last week, and ownership transferred to Dev after the reorganization.
The initial design stored one snapshot, whereas the approved design retains a revision chain.
That benchmark was invalidated when the tokenizer configuration changed on Tuesday.
The release target moved from Friday to Monday because the security audit remained open.
The old cap of four was superseded by the measured cap of eight.
We first classified this as a database fault, then corrected the diagnosis to an index rebuild fault.
negative: The request timeout is forty-five seconds.
The scheduler runs inside the application process.
Signed sessions are required for every read.
Clients send batches through the version two endpoint.
Dev owns the migration work.

concepts.name: decision_rationale
concepts.description: A selected engineering choice is connected to evidence, a constraint, a tradeoff, or a rejected alternative.

positive: We chose SQLite because one writer and durable local transactions fit the deployment shape.
Keep the embedding model on CPU so the reader can retain the limited GPU memory.
The team selected exact hydration to preserve quotations after summary-based routing.
Use a six-exchange queue because it hides ingestion behind normal reply time.
We rejected a document database since the bottleneck was index construction rather than row lookup.
The release uses immutable receipts so cached evidence can be audited later.
We capped graph traversal at two hops to limit hub drift and latency.
The proxy returns the provider response first because memory learning is asynchronous.
The implementation favors an extractive summary when the local generator is uncertain.
We retained the baseline route because experimental additions sometimes distract the reader.

concepts.name: measurement_result
concepts.description: An observed quantitative result is bound to its measured condition, population, or comparison rather than expressed as a target or estimate.

Median recall latency measured 1.08 seconds on the million-token archive.
The optimized cycle fell from 79.3 seconds to 46.7 seconds in the twelve-turn run.
Peak GPU allocation was 6.2 gigabytes with both local components resident.
The treatment recovered eight of the twenty-five previously missed checkpoints.
The cold backfill processed 783 summaries in 167.9 seconds.
Five independent runs averaged 94.6 percent accuracy.
The sparse index occupied 52 kilobytes at degree eight.
Reader output averaged 620 tokens across the evaluated questions.
The paired control completed in 1.02 seconds while the treatment took 1.07 seconds.
